scope: Independent exact-source review of protocol, isolated browser and actor harness. Remote model/bridge/supervisor/control source is separate and not approved by this record. No provider, live browser/site, model or media call.
conclusion: No additional concrete defect found in these final narrow source scopes after the append correction and prospective URL/action-budget amendments. Successful exact-source CPU/browser/video preflight and distinct wrapper/budget review remain required before any live model demo.

prior_finding.finding: clear=false promised append but used End, which reaches current line end in multiline textarea and can insert mid-value.
prior_finding.correction: Fixed Linux Chromium uses Control+End before typing. A fake multiline element test distinguishes whole-field end from line end.
prior_finding.status: confirmed in final source and pure test

prospective_amendments: Root observed the official initial paths redirect to exact same-origin /not-a-robot/embed/{1,3,5}; final route and final-frame checks admit only initial/canonical current-level paths with optional trailing slash. No query, different level, host or nested document wildcard is admitted.

Root prospectively changed both actors and all three levels from12 to32 action attempts after read-only observation of level5 rotating tiles. Batch8,90-second wall and levels1,3,5 stay fixed. Maximum96 policy requests per actor, with separate model wrapper owning one neutral warmup. No gameplay trial or outcome was used to amend this source.
checked: Fresh iframe elements and WindowProxy identities per level; exact official origin/current frame listener, one completion receipt per actor, inactive and old-level messages excluded.
Only actor-local screenshot and bounded rendered/accessibility DOM are exposed. Password values masked; script/style/template text excluded; no game variables, answer maps or scorer fields.
Coordinates restricted to actor iframe. Actual box must remain465x600 inside970x650 viewport. Physical browser actions serialized under one lock.
Indexed actions are atomically schema-validated then revalidated against current element identity, visibility and enabled state before execution. Queue suffixes are discarded at terminal/error.
Keyboard events focus a target from the correct frame; navigation shortcuts, arbitrary selectors/code, files and downloads are not actor actions.

Native completion after an actual returned actor action and within original wrapper-ready90-second interval determines success. Done self-report does not. Earlier/preexisting/late events do not earn ability credit.

Unknown policy/transport disposition aborts the whole demo, cancels sibling task and preserves partial report; no next request/level is admitted by the harness. Separate native-owning supervision is still mandatory.
Shared actor wall and peractor navigation/load/observation/action/completion times remain distinct. Native game timer synchronization and deterministic seed pairing are not asserted.
Six planned actor episodes and three-peractor denominator remain even after abort. Failed times are censored; final shared completion drain updates outcome/censoring.

Continuous side-by-side video is finalized only after context close; returned dimensions are configured capture dimensions until actual CPU media inspection. Artifact acceptance is not an OS write quota.

tests.kind: Pure fake scenes, fake elements and protocol checks; no browser/provider/model/game execution.

limits: Visible DOM filtering is rendered/accessibility filtering, not pixel-by-pixel occlusion proof. Coordinate clicks retain geometry but no semantic target identity.
Preflight and source inspection provide task familiarity; expose this in the demo record. Same level URLs do not establish same randomized puzzles.
Interactive assistant identity, cost and token counts are unknown absent trusted runtime metadata. This is not a verified Astra API comparison.
Async cancellation/browser close is not physical native stop, descendant disposal or billing proof.
The separate wrapper must preserve native-pending watchdog start during assistant progress and use exact total request/cost bounds.
No broad capability, speedup or world-best claim follows from three unpaired entertainment-game levels.
